ownerClarification.semanticBoundary: A project-wide Change ordinal exists only after the Change actually enters Explore; planned-only Changes do not own/reserve ordinals.
ownerClarification.archiveRule: Archive consumes the already-assigned current Change ordinal rather than allocating/recomputing it.

findings.summary: 023 incorrectly reserves project-wide Change ordinals from Delivery manifest planning slots. Ordinal must be assigned/frozen when a Change actually enters Explore; planned-only Changes consume no ordinal, and archive reuses the existing assigned number.

complexityAssessment.problem: Delivery planning slots are upgraded into global identity reservations.
complexityAssessment.target: MINIMAL: assign once at Explore, freeze, reuse through later Actions.
